name: result_synthesis_service.py
summary: Synthesizes a final structured answer from multiple search results by formatting them with citations and prompting an LLM to produce a JSON response, with robust parsing/repair logic, retries, and both streaming and non-streaming synthesis paths.

name: search_execution_service.py
summary: Executes a planned SearchStrategy by building a dependency-ordered execution plan, running document/SQL/summary/hybrid searches per instruction through the context provider, deduplicating, and ranking the combined results.

name: ask.py
summary: Provides a lightweight demo question-answering path that checks for a cached previous question, queries the SQL database for relevant data, and asks the standard LLM to produce a response.

name: doc_summary.py
summary: Implements document summarization for a session's uploaded files: extractive summarization via BERT (Summarizer) to select important sentences, dynamic sentence-count tuning, and LLM-based abstractive summarization across selected or all available folders.

name: sql_db.py
summary: Manages per-session SQLite database creation from uploaded CSV/Excel files, sanitizes identifiers, generates SQL queries from natural language via an LLM SQL chain, executes them safely, and stores generated table summaries.

name: adaptive_search_service.py
summary: Runs an iterative, multi-round search loop that progressively refines queries using LLM-based evaluation until results are deemed sufficient or limits are reached, deduplicating and combining content across rounds.

name: context_provider_service.py
summary: Centralizes retrieval of document, SQL data, and summary context for a user session, enriching search queries with conversational context (references, clarifications, continuations) before querying Elasticsearch, the SQL database, or the summarizer.

name: creative_reasoning_service.py
summary: Handles open-ended, creative-style query processing by running adaptive search, synthesizing results into a structured answer via LLM, and generating follow-up questions, with both streaming and non-streaming entry points.

name: llm_service.py
summary: Defines a custom LangChain-compatible chat model that talks to a self-hosted GPU inference server over HTTP, plus factory functions exposing pre-configured LLM instances tuned for different use cases (fast, standard, comprehensive, creative, code, streaming).

name: reasoning_strategy_service.py
summary: Analyzes a user's query with an LLM to produce a structured multi-step search strategy (decomposed sub-queries, types, priorities, dependencies), converting it into executable search instructions with a rule-based fallback when LLM parsing fails.

name: result_evaluation_service.py
summary: Evaluates whether accumulated search results sufficiently answer a query using an LLM-based judgment (with keyword-overlap fallback) and generates focused follow-up queries to fill identified gaps.

name: auth_service.py
summary: Provides a lightweight authentication service used across API blueprints to validate requests, derive session names, and issue tokens.

name: chat_history_manager.py
summary: Central service for persisting and retrieving chat history in MongoDB, handling session/chat naming, context retrieval strategies (recent, reference, adaptive, LLM-based), note-taking, session limits, cleanup, and deletion.

name: stt_service.py
summary: Speech-to-text service that connects to an external Vexyl STT backend over HTTP/WebSocket, transcribing audio bytes or streaming PCM audio chunks with language code translation.

name: tts_service.py
summary: Text-to-speech service that connects to an external Vexyl TTS backend, cleaning input text and streaming synthesized audio back via async-to-sync bridging.

name: auth.py
summary: Flask blueprint defining authentication-related API routes; currently exposes only a simple health check endpoint while real auth logic lives in auth_service.

name: documents.py
summary: Flask blueprint exposing document and container management routes: free-trial uploads, authenticated file/URL uploads, file retrieval, container renaming, listing, and deletion.

name: queries.py
summary: Large Flask blueprint that powers the query/chat experience: image captioning, trial and authenticated Q&A (sync and streaming), text-to-speech responses, speech-to-text transcription, chat history retrieval, renaming, stats, clearing, notes, demo queries, and chat context analysis.

name: chat_models.py
summary: Defines the core data model classes for the chat subsystem: query/role enums, chat messages, chat sessions, and chat context, including serialization to and from dictionaries.

name: document_service.py
summary: Core orchestration service that classifies uploaded files, routes them to document/data/URL processing pipelines, and manages document container lifecycle (create, rename, delete, fetch sessions) for the icarKno platform.

name: file_storage_service.py
summary: Manages on-disk storage of uploaded files per user session, including saving, locating, listing, and deleting files and session directories.

name: url_content_service.py
summary: Fetches and extracts content from arbitrary web URLs and YouTube videos (via transcript API or metadata scraping), converting results into LangChain Document objects for downstream ingestion.

name: delete_session.py
summary: Handles complete teardown of a user session: removing uploaded files from disk, deleting the associated Elasticsearch index, and clearing chat history.

name: upload.py
summary: Processes extracted document text into hierarchical markdown-aware chunks, persists raw/chunked text to disk, and stores documents into Elasticsearch for hybrid search.

name: extractText.py
summary: Multi-format text extraction utility supporting TXT, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX files, with text cleaning, table-to-markdown conversion, and page/table metadata tracking; also runnable as a standalone CLI.

name: accounts.py
summary: Flask Blueprint exposing account management API routes for updating payment plans, checking payment/subscription status, and user login authentication.

name: account_service.py
summary: Service layer encapsulating account business logic for payment plan upgrades, payment status lookups, and user login, delegating persistence to the database controller.

name: query_service.py
summary: Core query orchestration service that processes trial, authenticated, and demo user queries, applying input guardrails, rate limits, language translation, and delegating to the query agent for answer generation.

name: database.py
summary: Database controller providing direct MongoDB-backed functions for trial fingerprint tracking, user rate limiting, account upgrades, password hashing/authentication, JWT session creation, and chat session management (rename, timestamp updates, deletion, listing).

name: guardrails.py
summary: Input security pipeline implementing sanitization, malicious pattern detection (e.g. prompt injection), and LLM-based classification, composed into a configurable SecurityPipeline used to validate user queries before processing.

name: config.py
summary: Defines the Flask application's configuration system: a BaseConfig with environment-driven settings (Elasticsearch, MongoDB, MySQL, JWT, rate limiting, Ollama, Vexyl STT/TTS, GPU server, document summary tuning) plus Development/Testing/Production subclasses and a ConfigFactory to select and validate the active config.

name: client.py
summary: Provides a singleton ElasticClient wrapper that lazily initializes and exposes a shared Elasticsearch connection, with ping and index_exists helper methods.

name: document_manager.py
summary: Manages storing documents into Elasticsearch with embeddings, including Unicode/Hindi-aware preprocessing before indexing via ElasticsearchStore; update/delete operations are stubbed as TODOs.

name: index_manager.py
summary: Manages Elasticsearch index lifecycle (create, delete, refresh, existence checks) using a custom mapping with dense_vector embeddings and Hindi/multilingual text analyzers.

name: retriever.py
summary: Implements hybrid (keyword + vector) document retrieval over Elasticsearch using an EnsembleRetriever, with LLM-based query enrichment that rewrites queries using chat context, plus a helper to fetch all chunks belonging to a table for full-table retrieval.

name: chat_context_service.py
summary: Detects whether a follow-up query needs prior conversation context (via regex patterns plus LLM fallback) and extracts the relevant slice of chat history to feed into downstream prompts.

name: query_agent_service.py
summary: Top-level orchestrator for the query pipeline: combines intent classification, chat context retrieval, document/data/hybrid context lookup, optional creative reasoning mode, and response generation into a single process_query entry point.

name: query_intent_service.py
summary: Classifies a user query's intent (general chat, summary request, data query, or document-context-needed) using an LLM-backed classifier so the query agent can route to the correct response strategy.

name: response_generator_service.py
summary: Generates the final natural-language responses for every query mode (general chat, document, data, hybrid, document-aware chat) by building mode-specific prompts, invoking the LLM, parsing structured JSON-like output, and translating results to the user's requested language.

name: translation.py
summary: Translation utility that delegates to a remote IndicTrans2 inference server, providing translate_to_indic and translate_to_english helpers for converting text between English and 23 Indic languages using FLORES-200 language codes.

name: __init__.py
summary: Application factory module that builds and configures the Flask app: sets up logging, loads environment-specific config via ConfigFactory, enables CORS, registers extensions and blueprints, and defines global JSON error handlers.

name: __init__.py
summary: API package barrel that centralizes registration of all Flask blueprints (auth, documents, queries, accounts) onto the application instance.

name: __init__.py
summary: Extensions package barrel that initializes Flask-Limiter rate limiting (with a proxy-aware real-IP key function) and ensures an asyncio event loop is available for the app.

name: run.py
summary: Project entry point script that creates the Flask app via the application factory in production mode and runs the development server bound to 0.0.0.0:5001.

name: .env.example
summary: Template listing all environment variables required to run icarKno, covering Elasticsearch, AI provider keys (Gemini, Mistral OCR, OpenAI), MongoDB/MySQL/Neo4j credentials, Bhashini and ElevenLabs speech keys, and GPU inference server settings.

name: api-documentation.md
summary: Comprehensive REST API reference for icarKno covering authentication, rate limits, document upload/session management, query and streaming endpoints, knowledge graph generation, payment/account management, multi-language translation, health checks, WhatsApp webhook integration, error handling, and example workflows with a Python SDK sample.

name: readme.md
summary: Top-level project README for icarKno, a document intelligence platform; describes features (document processing, hybrid search, AI capabilities, multi-language support), quick start/installation, usage examples, architecture diagram, project structure, configuration, deployment via Docker, and contribution guidelines.

name: requirements.txt
summary: Python dependency manifest pinning versions for the Flask/FastAPI web layer, document processing libraries, LangChain/Elasticsearch vector search stack, Hugging Face transformers and summarization models, multi-database clients (MongoDB, MySQL/SQLAlchemy), authentication, and web scraping utilities.

name: results.csv
summary: Benchmark/test results dataset capturing query latency and quality metrics for the document Q&A pipeline, recording per-user-ID question, HTTP status code, total response time, time-to-first-byte, answer length, estimated tokens/sec, an answer preview, error text, and a success flag.

name: .understandignore
summary: Gitignore-style exclusion list for the Understand-Anything analysis tool, with commented-out suggestions for ignoring caches, environment files, and test patterns during codebase scanning.

name: config.json
summary: Single-key configuration for the Understand-Anything analysis tool specifying that all generated output should be in English.

name: sachet_agent_backend_docs.md
summary: Comprehensive technical documentation for the Sachet Agent Backend covering architecture, application bootstrap, configuration, full API reference, service layer deep dive, RAG pipeline, Elasticsearch integration, database layer, utilities, data flow diagrams, dependencies, and a developer onboarding checklist.

name: load_test.py
summary: Standalone concurrent load-testing script that simulates multiple users hitting the /ask endpoint, measuring response time, time-to-first-byte, and answer length, then reports aggregate statistics and optionally exports results to CSV.

name: generate_samples.py
summary: Script that generates randomized sample disaster alert records (matching the Sachet alert schema) for use as test/demo data, such as sample_alerts.json.

name: sample_alerts.json
summary: Sample dataset of 100 MongoDB-style disaster alert documents (heavy rainfall, cyclone, storm surge, etc.) with fields for severity, certainty, geographic area, and timestamps, used for testing and demos.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package initializer marking the utils directory as a Python package; contains no executable code or re-exports.
